title: performance canary: enhanced auto-detection and rollout guards for latency/throughput regressions
author: Evan Park
description: Motivation: improve reliability of our continuous performance canaries by making detection adaptive to workload characteristics and by adding stronger rollout guards to prevent noisy rollouts and reduce incident blast radius. This change implements an adaptive-threshold detector that accounts for KV-cache hit rates and sequence-length distributions, introduces hysteresis and cooldown for alerting to reduce flapping, and adds an automated rollout-guard circuit that can progressively cut traffic or trigger rollback when regressions persist. The PR includes unit and e2e tests, updates to observability (new metrics and tags), a short docs/runbook update, and a canary tuning guide. Checklist: 1) Implement adaptive detector and KV-aware latency metric 2) Add hysteresis + cooldown behavior 3) Implement rollout guard with progressive traffic shifting and automatic rollback 4) Add tests (unit + e2e) 5) Update docs and runbook 6) Add telemetry and dashboards. Related work: ENG-4301 (canary hardening), ENG-4475 (kv-aware telemetry).

release_notes: - Adaptive canary detection that accounts for KV-cache hit-rate and sequence length distributions; reduces false positives during workload shifts; - Rollout guard circuit with progressive traffic reduction and automatic rollback on persistent regressions; - Hysteresis and cooldown to prevent alert flapping; - New canary metrics and dashboard tiles; - Docs and runbook updates for tuning guidance and incident playbook.
